boards.title: Your First Weekend at Lebanon Valley College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A chronological, under-21-safe route through Lebanon Valley College’s documented 2026 New Student Orientation weekend, from Thursday check-in through Saturday night.

cards.title: Start at Orientation Check-In
cards.subtitle: Thursday morning · Leedy Theater in Allan W. Mund College Center
cards.notes: Begin at Leedy Theater, collect your student ID and orientation materials, then note where your Orientation Leader group will meet.
cards.short_summary: The practical first stop for identification, materials, and your small-group assignment.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC schedules required Orientation Check-In from 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Thursday, August 20, 2026, at Leedy Theater, where students receive IDs and orientation materials.
cards.access_notes: For incoming students during New Student Orientation; the posted 2026 schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Connect Home and Campus
cards.subtitle: Thursday midday · Peace Garden
cards.notes: Bring a small amount of water from home and follow the self-led ceremony in the Peace Garden before the afternoon welcome sessions.
cards.short_summary: A school-specific transition ritual centered on arriving from home and joining campus.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC documents a self-led Water Ceremony at the Peace Garden as a tradition connecting home and campus through water brought from home.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Thursday, August 20, 2026; families are invited and the schedule may change.

cards.title: Join the First Class Photo
cards.subtitle: Thursday afternoon · Henry and Gladys Arnold Field
cards.notes: Wear the orientation shirt issued at check-in and arrive ready to gather with residential, commuter, and transfer classmates.
cards.short_summary: The incoming class assembles together for its first official LVC photograph.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC schedules a required incoming-student Class Photo at Arnold Field and invites transfer and commuter students to participate in orientation shirts.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for 3:45–4:05 p.m. on Thursday, August 20, 2026; required for incoming students and subject to change.

cards.title: Ease Into the First Evening
cards.subtitle: Thursday night · Lehr and Phillips Dining Hall
cards.notes: Head to the dining hall for a low-pressure game night; bring your orientation details so you can return to your residence afterward.
cards.short_summary: A structured first-night activity with bingo and college-essential prizes.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC lists Card Bingo from 8–10 p.m. in Lehr and Phillips Dining Hall, describing an on-campus game with college-essential prizes.
cards.access_notes: Orientation activity scheduled Thursday, August 20, 2026, from 8–10 p.m.; the posted schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Mark the Academic Opening
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · Frederic K. Miller Chapel
cards.notes: Arrive at Miller Chapel before the procession begins and follow Orientation Leader directions for seating and the receiving line.
cards.short_summary: LVC formally opens the academic year with new students and robed campus leaders.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC identifies Opening Convocation as the tradition marking the formal opening of the academic year, including a receiving line with faculty, administrators, and trustees in regalia.
cards.access_notes: Required for incoming students at 10 a.m. on Friday, August 21, 2026; the posted schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Find Bishop Library’s Atrium
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Vernon and Doris Bishop Library
cards.notes: Walk to the library after academic orientation, take the complimentary break, and use the visit to learn the building’s location.
cards.short_summary: A brief refreshment stop that doubles as an introduction to the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC schedules a Coffee & Cookie Break in the Bishop Library atrium and states that complimentary coffee and cookies are available after academic orientation.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled from 1–3 p.m. on Friday, August 21, 2026; complimentary refreshments are stated, and the schedule may change.

cards.entity_name: LVC Football Scrimmage at Arnold Field
cards.title: See Arnold Field in Game Mode
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Henry and Gladys Arnold Field
cards.notes: Return to Arnold Field for the scheduled scrimmage and follow posted athletics or orientation guidance for spectator access.
cards.short_summary: An early chance to experience a Flying Dutchmen athletics gathering on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC’s 2026 orientation schedule lists a 7 p.m. football scrimmage against Thaddeus Stevens Tech at Arnold Field and invites students to support the team.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for 7 p.m. on Friday, August 21, 2026; confirm the orientation schedule because events are subject to change.

cards.title: Meet Classmates on the Social Quad
cards.subtitle: Friday night · Social Quad
cards.notes: Drop into the quad for yard games or crafts, then stay for the outdoor movie if weather and the posted schedule allow.
cards.short_summary: A casual outdoor gathering combining activities, conversation, and a movie.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC lists Party on the Quad from 8–10 p.m. on the Social Quad with yard games, crafts, and an outdoor movie beginning at 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Friday, August 21, 2026, from 8–10 p.m.; outdoor programming and the posted schedule may change.

cards.title: Start Saturday With Service
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Frederic K. Miller Chapel
cards.notes: Meet at Miller Chapel prepared for a hands-on project, and follow staff instructions about the activity, supplies, and destination.
cards.short_summary: A required orientation block connecting practical service with future campus opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC schedules Introduction to Service at Miller Chapel and says incoming students will complete a hands-on project while learning about service opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Required for incoming students from 9:30 a.m.–1 p.m. on Saturday, August 22, 2026; details may change.

cards.title: Close Saturday With Team Puzzles
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · Social Quad
cards.notes: Join a team on the Social Quad and rotate through trivia, word games, Sudoku, or the event’s supervised cold-case challenge.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative puzzle night designed to mix conversation with structured challenges.
cards.evidence_claim: LVC describes Solve & Socialize as a team activity featuring trivia, famous unsolved cold cases, Sudoku, crosswords, and word searches on the Social Quad.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled from 8–9:30 p.m. on Saturday, August 22, 2026; confirm location and timing because the schedule may change.
